answer_1.quote: Our experiments will be focused on the task of open-ended language generation ... We conduct experiments on the wiki-103 dataset ... We also discuss dialogue response generation and machine translation as related settings.

answer_2.quote: We also use popular NLG metrics including BLEU / Nist / METEOR ... and backward-BLEU / n-gram entropy ... We also adopt total variation distance (d_TV) and Jensen-Shannon divergence (d_JS) as distributional measures.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation with Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT)... The turkers are shown with a context and a corresponding generation, and they are asked to rate the quality (how grammatical / informative / logical) and the consistency (how related the generation is to the context).
answer_4.guideline: Turkers rate each generation on a 0‑5 scale for quality and for consistency, with optional half‑point scores; quality is judged disregarding errors in the context, and consistency evaluates relevance to the provided prefix.
